text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...!!
Hah, haaah, ...haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, I couldn't win...!
I couldn't reach them—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(...The cherry blossom crown I've longed for all this time...
It's still so far away...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Heeeeey, Rhein Kraft!!
That was a great runーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You bet, Craftーー!!
You were so cool! I'm so movedーー!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That speed was insane!!
I can't wait for your next raceーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah... everyone—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...Right. I don't have time to be feeling down!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(This is no time to show such an unsightly side of myself!
My challenge is still far from over!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
From the Oka Sho straight to the NHK Mile Cup!
I'm gonna keep challenging myself...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes.
That's right.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: If that is what your heart tells you.
...And then, a few days later.
A press conference was held, bringing together the four racers—including Rhein Kraft—who had fought a fierce battle and captured everyone's attention in the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: “—I see! So both Cesario-san and Air Messiah-san will continue on the Triple Tiara route as planned, then.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. My next race is the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To become the cornerstone
of the Tiara's enduring history—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The throne of the "Queen of the Oaks" will be mine.
...Without fail!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I believe I am well aware of
Cesario-san's prowess in medium-distance races."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "However, I have no intention of backing down either. So as not to disgrace my mother's name—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No. ...I will bring results worthy of elevating
my mother's name even higher. I swear it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!!
Next up, Line Kraft-san—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
I am—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...I'm going to set my sights on the NHK Mile Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooohhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"'I heard the rumors, but... are they serious?!'
'A girl from the Tiara route, no way...'
'This is massive news!!'"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"I've never heard of such an unorthodox rotation!"
"Is it a speed-first Tiara version of the Mile Championship rotation?"
"If this actually happens, it's gonna be crazy interesting...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...The 'NHK Mile Cup' is the only mile GⅠ race
where the sole requirement
is to be a Classic-tier Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whether they aim for the Triple Crown road,
the Triple Tiara road,
or the Sprint and Mile circuits—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's a race where all the speed-proud Umamusume
who will shape the next era gather together
to decide who's the fastest!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I will take 1st place there.
I swear I will, no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And—I will show all the Umamusume who set out on the Tiara path from now on!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them my back as someone to look up to—
proving that such possibilities and such futures really exist!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...!!
I think that's a wonderful challenge to take on!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And lastly, Daring Heart-san!
Could you share your thoughts on your next race?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Just as she declared that she would 'become the future Queen,'
is she heading for the Yushun Himba (Oaks)—?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: My next race will be...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —The NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh, ...wha!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san is entering the NHK Mile Cup too...!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you, Rhein Kraft.
